content:
Bombora is a platform that helps businesses figure out which other companies are looking for products or services online. It looks at what people are reading and searching for on a lot of different websites.This helps businesses focus on the companies that are most likely to buy from them.

How does Bombora work?

Bombora collects information from a group of business websites and publishers. It looks for patterns that show when companies are really interested in something. This helps businesses know which companies to target.

Bombora has a few tools that help businesses, including

  • Integration with marketing and sales platforms
  • Information about companies
  • Analysis of what topics companies are interested in
  • Collecting intent data from its big group of contributors

By using intent data, businesses can

  • Make their marketing efforts more effective
  • Get their marketing and sales teams working together
  • Focus on the companies that are most likely to buy from them
  • Identify companies that are ready to make a purchase

Core Technology Powering Bombora

Company Surge Data

actively recognizes businesses researching precise topics by examining content consumption types across a huge B2B publisher network. 

Data Co-op Network

a distinctive ecosystem where top B2B firms contribute & access shared intent data, thus ensuring more reliable, deeper insights into buyers’ behavior.

What makes Bombora Stand Out?

  • It is a reliable source of intent data.
  • It has a network of top-quality contributors.
  • It gathers information in a manner that respects people’s privacy.
  • It helps businesses target the companies.
  • It works well with marketing and sales platforms.

A Glance at the Key Features of Bombora

  • Data solutions- helps businesses identify companies that are looking for specific products or services.
  • Data integration services- helps businesses connect intent data to their marketing and sales tools.
  • Account-based marketing support- helps businesses target the right companies.
  • Sales intelligence- helps sales teams focus on the companies.
  • Programmatic advertising data- helps businesses make their online ads more effective.

Advanced Capabilities of Bombora You Should Know

  • Real-time intent insights- helps businesses know what companies are looking for now.
  • Data-driven campaign optimization- supports businesses to make their marketing efforts more successful.
  • Scalable data coverage- Bombora can help businesses of all sizes.
  • Custom top taxonomy- Bombora can help businesses target specific industries or topics.
  • Predictive targeting- allows businesses anticipate what enterprises will be looking for in the years ahead.

Who Should Use Bombora?

  • Mid-sized businesses that desire to perk up their marketing & sales efforts.
  • Large businesses that want to identify more about what their customers are in search of.

Best-Fit Industries for Bombora

  • Advertising and Media-media and marketing firms emphasizing on campaign performance, audience targeting, & data-driven advertising strategies.
  • Professional Services- advisory, legal, and consulting firms that count on intent insights to enhance engagement and client acquisition.
  • Manufacturing- production-focused business utilizing intent data for optimizing sales pipelines and strengthening the supply chain demand planning.
  • Life Sciences and Healthcare- healthcare providers, biotech, and pharma leveraging data to connect with the appropriate audiences and enhance decision-making.
  • Financial Services- Fintech, banking, and insurance firms focusing on targeted marketing,
  • compliance, and customer insights.
  • Technology and Software- innovation-driven & fast-paced companies using intent data for accelerated growth and identifying high-value prospects.

Bombora Top Use-Cases

  • Pipeline acceleration –helping businesses make deals faster.
  • Programmatic advertising –making online ads more effective.
  • Content strategy optimization –creating content that resonates with customers.
  • Sales prioritization –helping sales teams focus on the companies
  • Demand generation- creating leads and sales opportunities.

PROS

  • It helps businesses target the companies.
  • It is scalable for businesses of all sizes.
  • It has a range of integrations with other marketing and sales platforms.
  • It has account-based marketing and demand generation capabilities.
  • It respects people’s privacy and collects high-quality information

CONSIDERATIONS

  • It requires a strategy to be effective.
  • It can be expensive.
  • It can be complicated for businesses that are new to intent data.
  • It requires integration to get the most out of it.

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • G2 – provides buyer intent data from software research behavior.
  • TechTarget – provides data from its own media properties.
  • Demandbase – provides advertising and account-based marketing capabilities.
  • ZoomInfo – provides contact and company data.
  • 6sense – provides account engagement & predictive analytics.

Takeaway

In short, Bombora is a wonderful tool that allows businesses to recognize and engage with firms that are likely to purchase from them. Its sophisticated analytics and exceptional data collection make it an excellent solution for businesses that want to enhance their marketing & sales efforts.

Ready to make marketing decisions and enhance lead quality? Using Bombora’s intent data can be a true game-changer for your business.
